newsitem.title: USA: Seagull bids $4.2 mln for offshore tracts.
newsitem.headline: Seagull bids $4.2 mln for offshore tracts.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said Thursday it participated in the apparent high bids on 10 federal offshore tracts in the Central Gulf of Mexico offshore lease sale conducted Wednesday.
Seagull said it and its partners bid $7.3 million, of which $4.2 million is net to Seagull's interests, for the 10 tracts.
The company said it sought another eight tracts in which others submitted higher bids.

Two of Seagull's successful bids were at Eugene Island 153 and 154, each of which is adjacent to Eugene Island 135, where Seagull and partners have already drilled one successful exploratory well and plan another test before mid-1997, the company said. Seagull's partners at Eugene Island 135 joined the Company in bidding for Eugene Island 153 and 154.

Bidding without partners, Seagull was also the high bidder at East Cameron 133, East Cameron 152, East Cameron 153 and West Cameron 379. In tandem with partners, the company said it submitted the highest bids for East Cameron 166, East Cameron 167, Vermilion 114 and Vermilion 153.
